intro: Industrial and energy sectors bore the brunt of OT-security incidents between April 13 and April 28, 2026, with global impacts concentrated in North America, Europe, and the Middle East. APT33 and Pro-Russia Hacktivists were observed targeting critical infrastructure, while CVE-2026-24032 (CVSS 7.3) featured prominently among the nine reported events. The severity mix included one critical, three high, one medium, and four informational reports.
